'''''Koh-Lanta 2013''''' was the planned sixteenth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'', but was canceled on the first day of filming following the death of one of the the castways; it was never broadcast. 

== Production ==

The season was being filmed on Koh Rong, a Cambodian island off the southwestern coast near Sihanoukville. However, production was interrupted and cancelled when, on March 22, 2013, TF1 announced that a contestant had died during the first day of filming for the season being filmed Cambodia. The teams were repatriated and filming was cancelled. Gérald Babin, a 25-year-old man who suffered violent cramps from the start of the first challenge suffered a heart attack. He was resuscitated but his heart stopped again on arrival at Sihanoukville hospital, where he eventually died. The 17 remaining contestants and much of the production crew were subsequently sent back to France. Contemporary reports put the production contingent at approximately 80 technicians, in addition to the contestants. The contestants arrived back in Paris on March 25, 2013, where they were received at TF1's headquarters by network and production executives. A psychological-support system was also established for the contestants and relatives affected by the tragedy.<ref>https://www.lemonde.fr/actualite-medias/article/2013/03/28/la-production-de-koh-lanta-porte-plainte-pour-diffamation_3149901_3236.html</ref><ref>https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/french-survivor-season-canceled-death-430640</ref><ref>https://www.jeanmarcmorandini.com/article-302148-koh-lanta-la-famille-de-gerald-babin-est-partie-au-cambodge-aucune-enquete-judiciaire-ne-sera-ouverte.html</ref><ref>https://www.stars-actu.fr/2013/03/koh-lanta-les-candidats-viennent-de-rentrer-chez-eu/</ref>

On April 1, 2013, Thierry Costa, a doctor who worked on ''Koh-Lanta'' for 4 years, committed suicide in the wake of the controversy. In his suicide note, he stated that his name had been "tarnished in the media", which led to his death.<ref>https://www.huffingtonpost.com/2013/04/01/thierry-costa-suicide-french-survivor-doctor_n_2993370.html</ref>

No contestant from this cancelled season was retained in the cast of subsequent seasons.<ref>https://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/koh-lanta-ces-oublies-de-la-saison-13-annulee-qui-s-illustrent-ailleurs_f167fa0a-1344-11e9-aaae-c83fe80d860c</ref><ref>https://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/elian-casini-koh-lanta-le-temps-passant-c-est-l-incomprehension-qui-predomine_b8788a7a-56ff-11ea-a3e1-13c84824f7bc</ref>
